verdict.rationale: Quantization-format support is a fair question for a local LLM runner, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only says LM Studio runs models via llama.cpp or Apple MLX and supports MLX models. Nothing in the pack mentions loading FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ quantized models, or any quantization format at all.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ
